title.text: JitPass offboarding: remove it all, back to the start

decisions.text: Decided 2026-09-18: files are always restored before anything is deleted, and one failure deletes nothing. One Touch ID. Red appears once, on the button that commits. Amber marks the only real loss: secrets with no file to return to. The recovery screen shows only when such secrets exist. The last click is the user's: Trash for a website install, the brew line for Homebrew, no helper. From the code audit: a file edited since migration keeps today's version beside it; shell history and AI caches are not un-cleaned. End state: reinstalling opens onboarding at Welcome.
